statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Overnight Nasdaq-100 conditions remain narrow and orderly two hours before the US August employment report at 12:30 UTC.
recommendation: Assessment favours a narrow evidence-based danger window around the payrolls release rather than a session-wide restriction; Tail remains below the block threshold on current evidence.
headline: Narrow, orderly overnight range into the August payrolls report, with supportive cross-assets and no observed one-way structure
body: NQ futures trade near 29,630, about +0.36%, inside an overnight range of roughly 29,482 to 29,644 that spans only about 0.55%. That band is unchanged in character from the previous hour: the drift holds the upper half of the range without repeated extension, so retracement opportunity is intact. The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed Sep 3 at 29,482.32, up 1.16%, with a day range of 29,160.96 to 29,538.76, after Fed Governor Christopher Waller signalled he could support a September hold if disinflation persists, cutting September hike odds to roughly 50% from about 63% and easing the 10-year yield to about 4.75%. Cross-asset conditions are not aligned against the index. The 2-year is near 4.34% and the 10-year near 4.76%, both lower overnight; the H.15 release for Sep 2 shows 4.39% and 4.79%. VIX closed at 14.32, down 5.79%. Asian equities extended the move, with the Nikkei up 0.8%, Chinese blue chips up 1% and the Kospi up 1.1%. Two standing macro threads are carried as Stress rather than as evidence of a pathological path: WTI near $91.41 is up roughly 10% on the week and 21% on the month on Strait of Hormuz disruption without transmitting into sustained index downside, and the yen at 155.7 has gained 2.6% on the week with a September Bank of Japan hike about 75% priced, which keeps a carry-unwind channel live. The August Employment Situation at 12:30 UTC is the defining checkpoint, with consensus near +53K to +58K payrolls against a prior of -23K and an unemployment rate consensus of 4.1%. Previews flag one-time distortions that widen the plausible outcome range. Consistent with the framework, event importance and forecast dispersion are scored into Stress and Confidence rather than into the assessed pathological price-path risk until persistent one-way structure is actually observed. Shared latest-session cross-asset context was consulted and corroborates the independently verified picture: broad megacap strength on Sep 3 with wide internal dispersion, notably Tesla up 5.4% against Broadcom down 2.7% despite an earnings beat, which argues for rotation rather than single-direction index pressure.

lookbackSummary: The past 24 hours are fully covered by published Claude assessments. Conditions were benign through the European session on Sep 3 with Tail near 13 and the mode assessed as normal, shifted to trend-up with Tail peaking at 21 across the US cash session as the Waller-driven rally developed, then decayed through the evening as the move matured. Overnight into Sep 4 the mode returned to normal with Tail between 12 and 15 and Stress easing to the low 50s before edging back up on proximity to the payrolls report.
outlookSummary: The baseline path holds a low-amplitude range through the European session, with Stress building into the 12:30 UTC August employment report. The release hour and the following digestion hour, which contains the 13:30 UTC cash open, carry the widest two-sided repricing risk of the window and are modelled at Tail 23, which maps to WATCH rather than a block. This is consistent with the framework treating event importance and forecast dispersion as Stress and Confidence inputs until persistent one-way structure is actually observed. Tail is modelled decaying through the US afternoon as the release is absorbed, with a small uplift into the final cash hour on position squaring ahead of the Labor Day holiday on Sep 7. CME equity index futures halt for the weekend at 21:00 UTC, so the final nine slots carry a closed-market floor with Confidence stepped down to reflect the absence of a live price path. The principal invalidation of this outlook would be observed post-release continuation with shallow or failed retracements, particularly through the 13:30 UTC cash open.
